memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in activities of daily living; lectures college classes, walks to campus without assistance.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative screen).
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 8 seconds (below cut‑off).
medicines: 5 regular (levocetirizine 5 mg OD, cetirizine 10 mg HS, betahistine 16 mg BD, silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD); polypharmacy – please review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports stable mood, enjoys teaching, denies anxiety or low mood.
carers: Mother, Mrs. Sita Rao – relationship mother.
goals: "I want to stay symptom‑free so I can continue lecturing and travelling."
